visual_connections.description: User requests route to CDN and responses return back to the user.
CDN routes requests to and serves static event content/assets from S3.
CDN forwards dynamic GraphQL queries and mutations to AppSync.
Reseller/OTA traffic enters through the CDN boundary.
CDN routes third-party REST API requests to API Gateway.
API Gateway triggers Lambda functions to process reseller bookings.
AppSync GraphQL resolvers invoke Lambda functions.
Direct DynamoDB resolvers connect from AppSync to DynamoDB over Lambda.
Lambda performs read and write operations on multi-tenant partitioned DynamoDB tables.
Lambda enqueues async messages into SQS queues.
SQS triggers Lambda for asynchronous post-processing and email reviews.
